text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S wasn't feeling well,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry.
For causing you... trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? —Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: You're a cop, aren't you?! Stay back!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? —I am... not a detective.

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text:
"Well, of course you won't admit it!
Take another step closer and I'll press the button!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
――What happens if I press it?

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Broadcast through the tower's radio waves, the sound of nails scratching a blackboard echoes from speakers all across the town!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That would be... a nuisance, surely.

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If you don't like that, let me go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I cannot allow that.
As a civic duty to this town—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I cannot overlook wrongdoing.

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Dammit! Then I'll just push through—

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whoa, so fast!? The switch is already...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I should've just pushed instead of talking.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer A
text_block_list.text: Police! Give it up!

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Aaah......

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I was able to fulfill...
my duty... as a citizen, wasn't I?

Perhaps she had a pleasant dream while resting.
Symboli Kris S seems to have recovered
her energy.

text_block_list.name: Culprit
text_block_list.text: Stop, don't touch that! Ah! The switch is—
(SCREEEEEEECH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It seems I failed to fulfill...
my duty as a citizen...

Perhaps unable to rest properly in the nurse's office,
Symboli Kris S has not returned to full strength.
